reviewed_interpretation: The single authoritative I027 execution consumed its fresh development-only authority, preserved exact NS/VAD shipping mirrors, and correctly excluded pre-ready targets from all counterfactual denominators. The denominator correction therefore worked as designed. However, the preregistered eligibility-coverage gates did not all pass: oracle-noise global eligibility was 0.8864610111, but oracle-speech global eligibility was 0.7449760145, below the frozen 0.75 gate; cafeteria oracle-speech eligibility was 0.5537084399, below the frozen per-domain 0.60 gate. All 168 target cases had at least one eligible target, and no scenario/SNR/reverb secondary coverage gate failed, so the remaining invalidity is specifically speech reference-readiness coverage rather than missing implementation identity or general corpus failure. Because the global and cafeteria speech gates failed, the emitted mean-only, concentration-only and both-reference rescue/preservation fractions remain non-authoritative diagnostic traces and must not be compared to rank components, select mappings, relax the eight-frame readiness threshold, or justify a shipping change. I027 selects no component, mapping, weight, threshold, tracker change, source candidate, or shipping change. The next independent diagnostic should explain the temporal/reference-arrival cause of pre-ready speech targets—especially in cafeteria—before any further component counterfactual is attempted.

invalid_observations.reason: The reference-ready denominator semantics are correct, but preregistered speech eligibility coverage failed globally and in cafeteria. Counterfactual fractions from this run are retained only as invalid-run traces and must not be used to rank mean, concentration, their joint reference, mappings, thresholds, or shipping candidates.

proposed_followup_hypothesis.rationale: Use entirely fresh public-development seeds and the unchanged shipping mirrors, but do not run component counterfactuals. For every raw disagreement target, record the causal prior ordinary-noise reference count, target frame/time from warmup, first frame/time at which the fixed eight-reference pool becomes ready, excluded-versus-eligible status, and ordinary-noise reference arrival/persistence summaries. Decompose readiness separately for oracle-speech and oracle-noise across noise domain, scenario, SNR and reverb, with special attention to cafeteria speech. The goal is to determine whether failed speech coverage comes from early target timing, scarce ordinary-noise reference arrival, or condition-specific ordering before designing any new reference mechanism.
required_gates: fixed eight-frame readiness definition retained as an observation boundary
all raw disagreement targets represented exactly once in readiness accounting
global and per-noise-domain raw target minimums
scenario/SNR/reverb readiness summaries reported without component counterfactual interpretation
prohibited: reinterpretation of I027 invalid component fractions
post-hoc lowering of the eight-frame readiness threshold

verification_limits: I027 is terminally invalid for its preregistered component-causal question because the global oracle-speech eligibility fraction missed the frozen 0.75 gate and cafeteria oracle-speech missed the frozen 0.60 per-domain gate; the run must not be rerun.
The global speech miss is small in absolute terms, but the preregistered threshold is authoritative and must not be relaxed after observing the data.
Eligible-only denominator semantics were correct and every target case contained at least one eligible target; this does not override failed population-coverage gates.
The raw rescue, attribution, gap-reduction and speech-preservation values from the invalid result are non-authoritative and must not be used to rank components or mappings.
Exact NS/VAD mirrors demonstrate implementation identity only; they do not rescue failed readiness coverage.
No validation-grade, blind, hosted-real, HIL, product-certification, confirmation, source-merge or release authority was consumed.
